subject: Night crew point-person swap + transport contingency for CloudCity booth
messages:
From: Leah Morgan <leah@cloudcityevents.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Venue hiccup tonight — potential room oversell / shuttle change

Hi Grace + Marissa,

Quick heads up — the venue just called: there's a last-minute block overlap in the hotel master list and they need to move 4 rooms to a partner property across town for the night (20 minutes away). The venue ops team can provide a shuttle run at 10:30pm but on a single van rotation (one return), so timing will be tight for the night crew changeover.

Can Redwood confirm:
- Who will be the on-site point person for the night shift if we need to coordinate on-the-ground room swaps?
- If shuttle capacity is insufficient, are you able to approve $80 per person rideshare vouchers for 4 crew?

I know this is late — want to avoid anyone being stranded. I've attached the venue's updated room log (we replaced guest names with last four of phone for privacy).

Leah
CloudCity Events — Production Coordinator
leah@cloudcityevents.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: venue_room_update.xlsx (stated in email, sent by ops)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Leah Morgan <leah@cloudcityevents.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Venue hiccup tonight — potential room oversell / shuttle change

Thanks for the heads up, Leah — appreciate the quick flag.

We'll pivot. I'm happy to be the night point person for Redwood tonight and handle the room swaps if you want me on-site to meet the shuttle. A few notes/asks:
- Please confirm the shuttle schedule (departure / return) and number of seats per run. If it's strictly single-run with 12 seats, we should prioritize the night shift lead + two floaters.
- If shuttle won't cover everyone, please allocate the $80 rideshare vouchers for up to 4 crew; Redwood will approve the incremental expense but I need formal confirmation so I can sign off.
- Marissa: can you send the final crew manifest and confirm who can be bumped/backfilled? I may request Vivek to pick up the 11pm-3am window to cover the lead role — he can be onsite by 9:30pm if we rebook his flight to 7:30pm.

I'll be reachable on +1 650-555-0133. If venue ops needs on-the-ground coordination I'll meet the shuttle at the loading dock.

Grace O'Connor
Field Events Manager, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0133
